scripts.test:audio: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/edge_agent -p 'test_*.py' && npm run test:audio -w @beehave/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @beehave/api" "npm run dev -w @beehave/web"
scripts.test: npm test -w @beehave/api && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p "test_*.py" -v && python3 -m unittest scripts/edge_agent/test_agent.py
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages docs scripts README.md *.json eslint.config.js
